text:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: Starting soft-unpin window for runtime v3.2 -> v3.3 in us-east-1 at 11:00 PT. Affected models: llama3q-bertq, gptx2-quant. Pinned SDKs: sdk-2.7.x. If issues, we’ll auto-fallback to runtime v3.2 for compatible models. https://go/redwood/ops/unpin-playbook :rotating_light:

alex: Quick Q — does this unpin change any kernel selection for quantized weights? Seen a perf delta on longseq tests before.

mara: Good call. The kernel selection can shift for int8 paths. We ran longseq perf in canary and saw ~6% median latency increase for llama3q-bertq at seq=2048. Tradeoff was ~12% cost reduction.

sri: Important SDK note: customers on sdk-2.6.x will report protocol mismatch for the new rolling header we added. We need to gate unpin for routes still pinned to 2.6.

ops-runner: Ops checklist snapshot:
```
1) Preflight: run canary in eu-west, us-east (50 req/s) for 30m
2) Telemetry: verify token-cost and latency dashboards, error rate <0.5%\n3) Rollback cmd: ./infra/deploy rollback --runtime v3.3 --region us-east-1 --confirm
4) Pinback cmd: ./infra/deploy pin --runtime v3.2 --model llama3q-bertq
```

jess: Can we get a quick mapping of which customer routes are still pinned to sdk-2.6? I’ll notify CSMs for any high-traffic tenants.

mara: @jess I pushed a query to infra tools: `select route, count(*) from requests where sdk_version like '2.6%' and region='us-east-1'` — returns 8 routes >100req/s. I’ll share IDs in DM.

alex: For the models: if longseq latency hits +10% in canary we should abort. Can we set the deploybot to pause auto-unpin on that signal?

deploy-bot: Ack. I can pause on telemetry alert `runtime.v3.3.latency.p90.delta > 8%` or on manual `deploy-bot pause <thread_ts>`.

ops-runner: Recommend staged rollout: 10% traffic -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 15m hold and automated telemetry check at each stage. If any stage fails, immediate rollback to v3.2 for affected model-group.

sri: Add SDK compatibility gate: if >1 route with sdk-2.6 and >200req/s, hold and alert SDK team.

jess: Noted. I’ll create a customer notification draft for the 8 high-traffic routes and add a support blurb.

mara: Small ops nit: gptx2-quant uses a different KV-cache layout on v3.3; cold-start mem is +200MB. Watch host OOMs during canary.

alex: If host memory climbs, do we prefer pinback or spin up higher-memory worker and continue canary?

ops-runner: Prefer pinback at stage failure threshold unless we’re within quota to spin larger workers without impacting other tenants. We’ll prefer safe rollback by default.

deploy-bot: Preflight started at 6345678905: canary in us-east-1 (10% traffic) and eu-west-1 (5% traffic). Telemetry hooks attached.

mara: Monitoring now — enabling longseq synthetic test. Will report p50/p90 in 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jess: Thanks all — I’ll stand by in case we need to send customer notices.

deploy-bot: Update 6345678930: canary metrics (us-east-1): llama3q-bertq p90 +7.1%, error rate 0.12%, mem usage +120MB. eu-west-1 similar. No SDK mismatches detected in canary routes.

alex: That p90 is within our abort threshold (8%) but close. Recommend proceed to stage 30% and keep strict monitoring.

ops-runner: Advancing to 30% at 6345678940. Hold timer 15m.

sri: Noted — sdk-2.6 routes still present but none in canary; raising an outbound ticket to SDK team to prioritize patch.

deploy-bot: Final: If anyone wants to abort: `deploy-bot pause 6345678901` or reply `abort` in thread.

jess: I’m good to continue. Will ping CSMs after 60% stage completes.

mara: Thanks team. I’ll post a short release note after rollout completes with perf numbers and memory caveats. :memo:
